name: get_dependencies
title: Dependencies
description: Package and module dependencies of projects, files, communities, or packages. Packages come from manifests and lockfiles, with the declared range, resolved version, scope, and whether the dependency is direct. transitive follows lockfile dependencies between packages. Modules are aggregated from imports, calls, and references: file to file for a file, community to community for a community, project to project for a project, and weight counts the underlying edges. direction in answers what depends on the target.

repo.description: Registered repository name. Optional: defaults to the repository that contains the server's working directory, or the only registered one.

targets.description: Project, file, community, or package IDs, or path:line locators (which resolve to the file here).

transitive.description: Also follow package-to-package dependencies from lockfiles.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; keep the other arguments the same.

items.description: By target as passed, then packages before modules, then heaviest first, then id.

version.description: Resolved version, when a lockfile gives one.

declared.description: The version range as the manifest writes it.

path.description: The manifest or lockfile that declares a package dependency.
